appName: Push Em All! Clear the Blocks
displayName: Push Em All! Clear the Blocks
display_name: Push Em All! Clear the Blocks
display_long_description:
The Ultimate Physics-Based Block Challenge in VR!

Get ready for a satisfyingly addictive puzzle experience with Push Em All! Clear the Blocks. Step into a focused virtual environment where your only goal is to clear the board by pushing every block into its rightful place. But be careful—each move requires strategy, precision, and a bit of physics-based logic!

Equip your high-tech pusher tool and start sliding blocks, dodging obstacles, and outsmarting the layout to become the master of the grid.

Why You’ll Love the Challenge:
Satisfying Physics Mechanics: Feel the weight and friction as you push blocks across the surface. The tactile feedback makes every "clear" feel incredibly rewarding.

Brain-Teasing Puzzles: What starts as a simple task quickly turns into a complex puzzle. Plan your path to ensure no block gets stuck in a corner!

Strategic Block Movement: Every block matters. Use your pusher tool to align them perfectly and slide them into the target holes to complete the level.

Immersive Table-Top Design: Play in a comfortable, realistic 3D environment. The table-top perspective is perfect for both seated and standing VR play on Meta Quest.

Master the Board: Progress through challenging layouts that test your spatial awareness and problem-solving skills.

Grab your Meta Quest controllers and see if you have the skills to Push Em All!
